en: As long as you live, shine,
do not grieve at all at anything;
life is for a short while,
notes: line 1.1: 'phainou' is 'appear, show yourself, shine': be seen, be bright while you live.
line 1.4: literally 'time demands back the end' (apaitei: to demand what is owed): time claims its due. 'To telos' can be the end or the fulfilment.
Romanization: accents left out, rough breathing as h, iota subscript written as i (zēis), eta and omega with macrons, upsilon as y.
